Fix review: blocked 1019d18de448a9569c65a704410c331046cbe868 carry-missing: not carried to #2428 #2436 #2437 #2429 #2438 (no owner, carry_audit BAD-DEST)

Round: first review of this head. Group: none (topic r10-rca-harness-friction; no group entry matched), so this was reviewed against the PR body. Measured at 1019d18de448a9569c65a704410c331046cbe868 (ev/HEAD.txt), from a detached worktree at that head.

RESULT step0 roles-current: git diff merge-base...origin/main -- dev/governance/roles/ is empty
RESULT step13 merge-tree origin/main(289426c1f) 1019d18de448a9569c65a704410c331046cbe868: rc=0, clean (ev/merge_tree.txt)
RESULT step10 carry: BLOCK. python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py check --body <PR body> gives rc=1: "12 finding item(s): 6 routed, 0 unrouted, 6 bad destination(s)". The ## Forward-carry items routed to #2428, #2436, #2437 (twice), #2429 and #2438 all fail with "has no owner: no live roster group lists it and there is no dev/programme/carries/carry-N.json". I got the same result at the head and at origin/main 289426c1f (ev/carry_audit.txt). These carries are not written into any stage that owns them, so step 10 blocks.
RESULT step11 CI: pr-contract is red on both runs (119209550896, 119209802161). Its job log fails at the carry_audit step with the BAD-DEST lines above. The body's "## Red checks" says "none" because it was written before the PR existed. env-matrix, instrument-self-tests, policy-docs, mutation, closure-scope, briefs and nightly-status were still running when I read CI (ev/check_runs.txt). Step 11 gates a root-cause-unanswered verdict on all of them finishing, so I am not blocking on that here. The carry block above stands on its own.
RESULT step1 mutation: the claims hold. M1 (step 6 put back to "harness: class-open <seam>"): rc=1, FAIL "teaches class-open as a reason under another class". M2 (shadowed returns null): rc=1, negative control FAIL. M3 ("mutation-vacous"): rc=1, taught-word arm FAIL. M5 (detector loop line deleted, with M1 applied): rc=0, so that loop is the line that kills M1. The tree was clean after each mutant (ev/mutants.txt). At the head: 202 passed, 0 failed.
RESULT step5 VERSION, manifest version, notes heading and tests/golden: untouched (empty three-dot diff)
RESULT cheap checks at head: policy_lint TOTAL 0 errors across 41 files. fix-review.md 140/140 lines and 2443/2451 tokens; orchestrator.md 318/319 and 4511/4513, as the body says. fold_ledger 0 violations. rules_sync --check rc=0 (ev/cheap_checks.txt).
RESULT step8 not re-derived: the window statistics (policy_lint --stats 234/116, rounds.py 102 blocked, class-open 26/15, and the minutes figures) need a 229-PR API sweep. I did not re-take them, so they are unverified, not confirmed.
RESULT step2/6: the finding has no finder harness apart from the detector and the census. The detector's seam (step 6) is closed in the diff. I did not re-run the census.
RESULT step7: the body names 1019d18de448a9569c65a704410c331046cbe868 as the head. The PR API head is the same.

To clear the block, the fixer can route each of those six carries to a live owner: a roster group that lists the issue, or dev/programme/carries/carry-N.json. Otherwise, use a destination that carry_audit accepts, then re-run pr-contract.

Round 3 of PR #2561 (R10-RCA-FRICTION), re-review after round 1's `blocked 1019d18de carry-missing` (comment 6315535889). Head measured: `2aea7f088607c1b86e0f42499d84c8b3aea1c9b0`, still the PR head when this verdict was written. Contract: `dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md` from main; `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...origin/main -- dev/governance/roles/` is empty, so the copy is current.

## Findings

- My own extra mutant M6 survives: deleting the `m[2] !== m[1] &&` guard in `shadowed()` (`tools/policy/check-wave-script.mjs`) leaves rc=0, 202 passed. No contract example and no control writes a reason that repeats its own class word, so the guard is unpinned. The PR's named mutants (M1, M2, M3, M5) all held. The fix is a one-line control, e.g. `shadowed('blocked <sha> harness: harness x') === null`, which the next group editing this file can add next to the null control. Carry: R10-BRIEFS-FOLD (item F1)
- Owed after the merge: once the orchestrator sets R10-RCA-FRICTION's `resume.stage` to `done`, #2428, #2429, #2436, #2437 and #2438 have no live owner again, so that roster edit must re-home them (body, Forward-carry, "Ownership after this merge"). The roster at abca772ee lists them under R10-RCA-FRICTION (in-progress), which is why carry_audit passes now. Carry: #201 (item F2)
- The body's `## Head` section has a paragraph naming `672b8723840f3855085f0e0b4352aa6fa87ed9e7`, which is not an object in the repository (`git cat-file -t` fails after a full fetch). It is a leftover duplicate of the paragraph above it. The head the body names, 2aea7f08, is the head measured. Carry: dismissed: stale descriptive paragraph, no gate or reader keys on it (item F3)
- The body's `## Red checks` reads 1019d18de's runs and says this head has not run CI yet. At 2aea7f08 every run has now concluded, and the one red, `nightly-status` 119505300381, reports the same scheduled run 39563978649 (mutation-nightly, slow) that the body answers. So the answer covers this head and only the wording is stale. Carry: dismissed: answer already covers the identical run, wording only (item F4)

## Evidence

- RESULT carry: `python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py check --body <PR body>`: `CARRY-AUDIT: 14 finding item(s): 14 routed, 0 unrouted, 0 bad destination(s)`, rc=0. The same with `--roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` (abca772eed0c83a92a472a373290648b093419bf): the same line, rc=0. On that roster R10-BRIEFS-FOLD, R10-POLICY-FIXER-MD and R10-POLICY-LINT-FAMILY each cite #2561. The PR adds no `dev/programme/carries/carry-N.json`, so no carry-file schema applies. Every Forward-carry item has a live owner (ev/carry_audit_body.txt, ev/roster_groups.txt).
- RESULT mutation (ev/mutants.txt, ev/M*.log): head rc=0, 202 passed. M1 (step 6 back to `harness: class-open <seam>`) rc=1. M2 (`shadowed` returns null) rc=1. M3 (step 1 misspelt `mutation-vacous`) rc=1. M5 (M1 plus the `if (w) t(...)` loop line deleted) rc=0, which confirms that loop line is the one that kills M1. M7 (drop `classes.includes(m[2])`) rc=1, 5 failed. These match the body's M1–M5 figures (202/201 passed, 1 failed).
- RESULT null control: main's `fix-review.md` under the head's detector gives rc=1, 200 passed, 1 failed, and the failure is the step 6 example. This matches the body.
- RESULT figures, re-taken at 2aea7f08 (ev/figures.txt): `policy_lint --budgets` fix-review.md 140/140 lines, ~2443/2451 tokens; orchestrator.md 317/319, ~4506/4513; corpus ~61138. `policy_lint` `TOTAL: 0 error(s) across 41 policy file(s)`, rc=0. `policy_lint_mutants` `MUTANTS ok`. `rules_sync --check` rc=0. `fold_ledger check` 0 violation(s). `tmp_paths --check` 0 refused. `structure.py` STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED. `closure.py select` `MODE: SCOPED -- 1 script(s) run, 32 scoped out`. `entities.py` (venv-ci 3.14, hastub) `ALL 2382 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED`, rc=0. `archscore/gate.py` `PASS: dS +0.0000 NULL, no gate metric rose`. No `*_budgets.json` is in the diff. All of these equal the body's figures.
- RESULT window: `git log --first-parent v7.0.0..df6ca4bc` gives 229 `Merge pull request #N`, and the set equals the committed `window_prs.txt`. The committed `blocked_rounds.tsv` holds 102 `#N` rows, matching the body's 102. The API-derived figures (`PRS 229 FAILURES 0`, the `policy_lint --stats --since v7.0.0` per-class counts such as harness 15/23, mutation (family) 7/8, carry-missing 12/15, and the 12-PR mutation union) were not re-derived by this seat. They need a 229-PR comment fetch, so they are not verified here.
- RESULT merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 2aea7f08` (origin/main 1ebc737e7) exits 0 with tree ac8311cac (ev/merge_tree.txt). The three merges since the reviewed code head (c42cc0d8a, 2cf7393b3, 2aea7f088) carry no combined-diff hunks. Branch-authored files are byte-identical between f7802ee36 and 2aea7f08, so the resolution delta is empty (ev/merge_resolution.txt).
- RESULT CI at 2aea7f08 (commit check-runs API, 49 runs, ev/check_runs_2aea7f08.txt): all concluded. Every run is success, skipped or neutral (CodeQL) except `nightly-status` 119505300381. That one grades main's scheduled run 39563978649 (mutation-nightly, slow failed), and this diff reaches nothing it reads. Its log states it is not one of the required contexts on `main-protect` and does not block a merge. The body answers it under `## Red checks`. Both `pr-contract` runs (119504959689, 119505181962) are success.
- VERSION, the manifest version and the RELEASE_NOTES heading are not in the diff. The claim files are not in the diff.
- Policy approval: the diff edits `fix-review.md` and `orchestrator.md`, so it merges only on tvofi's approving review. The body states that approval is owed and not yet given. This verdict is not that approval.
